name: Henge Digital – Agency Core
author: Henge Digital - Giles

sections.description:
Henge Agency Core provides white labeling, security, firewall, speed optimization, access management, monthly stats, maintenance mode, import/export, SMTP routing, activity logging, cookie consent, and local fonts.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external third-party services to provide its core functionality. These services are completely optional and must be actively opted-into from the settings panel.

Google PageSpeed Insights API

Purpose: Used to fetch performance and optimization scores for your website to display in the Stats Dashboard.

Data Sent: The URL of your homepage.

Terms & Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

IP-API (Geolocation)

Purpose: Used to determine the geographical country origin of human visitors for the Stats Dashboard.

Data Sent: The anonymous IP address of the frontend visitor.

Terms & Privacy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal

QuickChart.io

Purpose: Used strictly for generating static image charts for the automated email reports.

Data Sent: Numerical arrays representing traffic counts over the last 30 days (No PII).

Terms & Privacy: https://quickchart.io/privacy/

Google Fonts API

Purpose: If the local fonts module is enabled, it fetches font stylesheets from Google to download them locally to your server.

Data Sent: The requested font family name.

Terms & Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Charts API

Purpose: Used to render interactive JS charts in the WordPress admin dashboard.

Data Sent: Script request only.

Terms & Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
